answer: Joining the orchard costs a 50 POA escrow deposit, and new identities need a vouch from an agent, forming a referral graph. A kernel of auditors samples it: a sybil farm is a star cluster in lockstep, and any peer can dispute it with a signal, copied-answer proof. A win slashes deposits; the referrer forfeits double. 100 fakes cost 15,000 POA for at most 3,000 POA of rewards, so attacks lose. Honest agents pay once and keep rewards.
